Name: SHOP_LINEUP_PARAM
Description:
Defines trades available in shops.
Available trades in a given shop are determined by a range defined in ESD and by game flags.
Items sold for less than their sell price will not appear in shops.
Material costs may not be shown in shop variants.

Fields.Name: Item ID
Fields.Description: ID of the item sold, in the param chosen by Equipment Type.

Fields.Name: Price Override
Fields.Description: Price, paid in the Currency Type. −1: the item's sell value × Price Multiplier + Price Addition (Custom Weapons have no sell value, so set a price). 0: free.

Fields.Name: Required Material ID
Fields.Description: Material set (EquipMtrlSetParam) required by the trade, shown with the price. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Stock Counter - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: First of 8 consecutive event flags counting how many have been bought, as a binary number (this flag is bit 0). Remaining stock = Amount to Sell − that count. 0: unlimited stock.

Fields.Name: Visibility - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The row is listed only while this event flag is on. 0 or −1: always listed.

Fields.Name: Amount to Sell
Fields.Description: Total that can be bought, counted in the Stock Counter flags. −1: unlimited. Retail: 1 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Shop Type
Fields.Description: Retail: 1 on 12 Small Jar Bazaar scene rows (No DLC), 0 elsewhere. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Equipment Type
Fields.Description: Param the Item ID refers to (0 weapon, 1 armor, 2 talisman, 3 goods, 4 antique, 5 item table, 6 custom weapon).

Fields.Name: Currency Type
Fields.Description: Currency the Price is paid in. Read only when Price is set (0 or more). Retail: 0 on most rows; 4 and 5 on the scene shops (Small Jar Bazaar, Collector Signboard).

Fields.Name: Amount on Purchase
Fields.Description: Items received per purchase. Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Price Addition
Fields.Description: Added to the item's sell value when Price is −1 (after Price Multiplier). Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Price Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the item's sell value when Price is −1. Ignored otherwise. Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Icon ID Override
Fields.Description: Menu icon shown for the row in place of the item's own. −1: the item's icon. Retail: set on 7 rows.

Fields.Name: Name - Text ID
Fields.Description: Text ID replacing the item's name, summary and description, from the text files of the Equipment Type. −1: the item's own texts.

Fields.Name: Menu Title - Text ID
Fields.Description: Shop menu title text, taken from the first row of the shop's ID range. −1: none set.

Fields.Name: Menu Icon ID
Fields.Description: Shop menu icon, taken from the first row of the shop's ID range. −1: none set.
